title: MN follow-up fine label plan
decision: KEEP the 42 stored cmp amounts. Do not set them to NULL. Earlier NULL proposals for these 42 are dropped. This file is the current plan (labeling only). Historical attribution files remain as a record of the old proposal.
verified_current_cmp: 42/42 still equal the stored follow-up-letter totals (read 2026-11-27 ~6:58 PM PT). No amounts were changed in this step.

caveats: inspections.raw_data (jsonb) can hold a fine_label string with no DDL. The facility profile loader already selects raw_data.

The public site does not currently display inspections.civil_money_penalty_total at all. loadFacilityProfile does not even select that column. MN profileConfig has no followUp.showFine. Fine chips exist only for PA and IL, and they read deficiencies.civil_money_penalty (item-level), not the visit total.
So keeping these 42 amounts does not by itself change public pages, and a label will not appear until the site is taught to show it.
Putting the label in raw_data is fragile: MN ingest rebuilds raw_data from the directory/PDF payload and would likely overwrite an editorial key on the next refresh.
Do not use narrative_summary. facility_compliance_flags.banner_text and facility_data_quality_issues are facility-level admin fields, not visit-level public labels.
schema.recommended: A dedicated column is safer than raw_data. That is Blake's call. Proposed DDL is text only; not applied.
schema.site_change_also_required: Select civil_money_penalty_total and civil_money_penalty_note (or raw_data.fine_label) in loadFacilityProfile, and render them on the MN inspection block. Today MN shows neither.
